data.name: Resort in Need
data.description: Locals at the luxury resort are sending in an alarming amount of reports of jellyfish attacking everyone up and down the beachline. This is keeping the resort guests from enjoying their beach days!
data.successDescription:
"You report your findings and the wildlife team thanks you for your quick action.”
“We could never have done that without you. We owe you a lot.

objectives.description: Normally, this would be an issue for the wildlife department, and not the world's Shinobi. Except, the wildlife teams are saying the jellyfish are exhibiting attacks resembling something similar to jutsu’s. The wildlife team is ill-equipped to handle this kind of thing and asks you to help. Please assist in investigating the unusual activity.

nextObjectiveId.text: How strange. I’ll depart immediately.
Not my problem. I don’t like the beach.

objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent

objectives.description: While fighting them you noticed something was off. Investigating the bodies, you get a strange feeling as if you’re being watched. You look off into the distance, you barely notice a massive, almost translucent, body dip down in the depths of the ocean. You need a boat to get out to see. Heading to the marina is the best place for that. You see one down at the end of the peninsula and make your way there.

nextObjectiveId.text: Charter a boat
No thanks. Boat’s make me seasick.

objectives.description: You arrive at the marina and track down the harbor master.

nextObjectiveId.text: Hello, I’m looking to charter a boat to track down a sea monster that’s been seen off shore.

objectives.description: Hello master Shinobi. That is a big ask for some to give you a boat to chase down monsters. I’m not too sure most people would be willing, or have a boat fast enough to do it.

nextObjectiveId.text: Please, there must be at least one. It’s for the sake of the town and the resort.

objectives.successDescription: Hello master Shinobi. That is a big ask for some to give you a boat to chase down monsters. I’m not too sure most people would be willing, or have a boat fast enough to do it.

objectives.description: Well….there is one boat. The one I built many years ago. She should be fast and strong enough to get you there. And while I’m not as young as I used to be, I’m still a pretty good sailor. Give me a bit of time to get her launched and on the sea once again.

nextObjectiveId.text: Perfect, just let me know when you’re ready!

objectives.description: Now that you have the boat, you head out to sea where you last saw the massive body.

nextObjectiveId.text: Set sail!

objectives.description: Track the chakra.
Once you arrive, you sense a massive amount of chakra. This luckily makes tracking whatever was here much easier.

nextObjectiveId.text: Track the chakra.

objectives.description: While tracking the chakra, some jellyfish rise from the water's surface and attack!
objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent

objectives.description: While fighting the jellies off, the ship got damaged and started taking on water. The harbor master tells you he can’t continue and he has to turn back or you will all drown.

nextObjectiveId.text: Turn around back to shore to make repairs.

objectives.description:
Back to shore, the harbor master informs you of the situation.

Welp. This doesn’t look good. I don’t have the proper tools myself anymore to fix up my ship. However, I’d be willing to let you charter her again if you can get me the tools needed to fix ‘er up. What do you say?

nextObjectiveId.text: Done! Where can we get those tools?

objectives.description: The best ship builders I know of are in Akasumi. I’m sure if you head there, you’ll find the proper tools.

nextObjectiveId.text: On it.
Sound's like work I don't wanna do.

objectives.description: Collect Shipwrights tools
You’ve managed to find the exact tools the harbor master needs to repair his ship.

nextObjectiveId.text: I better head back to give these tools to the harbor master asap!

objectives.description: Head back to the Harbor Master

“I must say, I’m impressed with your speed on collecting the needed tools. I wasn’t even fully sure if they’d have everything we need to get repairs done. I’ll start working right away, and get her back out to the open waters.

nextObjectiveId.text: Wait for the repairs to be completed.

objectives.description: While waiting for the repairs to be completed, you still get reports of, and help defend against  jellyfish attacks. However, you have not seen the massive body again.

nextObjectiveId.text: Continue

objectives.description: Alright master shinobi. Repairs are completed and we can set sail. I just don’t know where you would start though. It’s been about a week since we were last out there. Who knows where that thing is at.

nextObjectiveId.text: I’ve seen it just recently. We can head out to where I last saw it.

objectives.description: Head to 22,9

You make your way to the last location you saw the monster. The familiar chakra hits you almost immediately. You give directions to the harbor master as you follow the chakra trail. As you make your down further, you see jellies rising up to attack. This time, you’re ready for them!

nextObjectiveId.text: Defend the boat!

objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent

objectives.description: During the battle you were able to see what the massive body is. A giant Jellyfish Chakra Beast. You know you can’t beat this thing. You must seal it away before things get too bad! You chase after it as it dives deeper into its domain.

nextObjectiveId.text: Dawn special underwater breathing gear to seal the beast away.
This is way above my paygrade

objectives.drawDescription: The battle ended in a draw
objectives.failDescription: You failed to defeat the opponent

objectives.description: You have successfully sealed the chakra beast. As this completes, you see the other jellyfish start to calm down and return to normal. On your way back to shore, you see the jellyfish pulling away from the shore and back out to sea.

nextObjectiveId.text: Seems like things are returning to normal. I better check in with the wildlife team.

objectives.successDescription:
“You report your findings and the wildlife team thanks you for your quick action.”
“We could never have done that without you. We owe you a lot.

objectives.description: After about a week of constant attacks and scanning the horizon for signs of the monster, you see it rise once again from the depths for a brief moment. Lucky for you, the harbor master's ship’s repairs are about to be done.

nextObjectiveId.text: Continue
